description: Counter-metrics (spec §12.5, PRD §13.1): change failure of auto-approved against human-approved merges, and incidents on quiet, quick merges.

panels.description: Merged PRs whose head Exemplar's gates approved, later reverted or linked to an incident (PRD §13.1).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE reverted OR incident) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Change-failure %"
FROM merge_outcomes WHERE auto_approved AND $__timeFilter(merged_at)

panels.title: Change failure: auto-approved

panels.description: Every other merged PR, same definition.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE reverted OR incident) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Change-failure %"
FROM merge_outcomes WHERE NOT auto_approved AND $__timeFilter(merged_at)

panels.title: Change failure: human-approved

panels.description: Merged PRs whose head passed every gate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Merges" FROM merge_outcomes WHERE auto_approved AND $__timeFilter(merged_at)

panels.title: Auto-approved merges

panels.description: All merged PRs later reverted or linked to an incident.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE reverted OR incident) AS "Failed" FROM merge_outcomes WHERE $__timeFilter(merged_at)

panels.title: Reverted or incident-linked

panels.description: Share of each week's merges later reverted, auto-approved against human-approved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', merged_at) AS "time", CASE WHEN auto_approved THEN 'auto-approved' ELSE 'human-approved' END AS "metric",
  (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE reverted) / count(*))::float8 AS "revert %"
FROM merge_outcomes WHERE $__timeFilter(merged_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revert rate by week

panels.description: Merged PRs per week, auto-approved against human-approved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', merged_at) AS "time", CASE WHEN auto_approved THEN 'auto-approved' ELSE 'human-approved' END AS "metric", count(*)::float8 AS "merges"
FROM merge_outcomes WHERE $__timeFilter(merged_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Merges by week

panels.description: Incident-linked merged PRs where Exemplar posted nothing and the merge came within an hour of its first review, or the gates approved it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.merged_at AS "Merged", o.repo AS "Repo", o.pr_number AS "PR", 'https://github.com/' || o.repo || '/pull/' || o.pr_number AS "Link",
  o.auto_approved AS "Auto-approved", round(extract(epoch FROM o.merged_at - min(r.started_at)) / 60.0) AS "Minutes from first review",
  (SELECT string_agg(l.ref, ', ') FROM pr_links l WHERE l.repo = o.repo AND l.pr_number = o.pr_number AND l.kind = 'incident') AS "Incidents"
FROM merge_outcomes o JOIN reviews r ON r.repo = o.repo AND r.pr_number = o.pr_number AND r.caller = 'production'
WHERE o.incident AND o.findings_posted = 0 AND $__timeFilter(o.merged_at)
GROUP BY o.merged_at, o.repo, o.pr_number, o.auto_approved
HAVING o.auto_approved OR o.merged_at - min(r.started_at) < interval '1 hour'
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Incidents on quiet, quick merges

panels.description: Every merged PR later reverted or linked to an incident, with what Exemplar posted on it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.merged_at AS "Merged", o.repo AS "Repo", o.pr_number AS "PR", 'https://github.com/' || o.repo || '/pull/' || o.pr_number AS "Link",
  o.auto_approved AS "Auto-approved", o.reviewed AS "Reviewed", o.findings_posted AS "Findings posted", o.reverted AS "Reverted", o.incident AS "Incident"
FROM merge_outcomes o WHERE (o.reverted OR o.incident) AND $__timeFilter(o.merged_at) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 500
